dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you! Thanks so much for your help previously.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: Are you here to try your hand at making some fireworks?

choices.text: What sorts of fireworks can I make?

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: Oh, lots and lots! I could be here all day and not finish talking about them. That said, I've written some basic formulas down for you.

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: Go ahead, have a gander at them!

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: I have faith that you'll be able to make some lovely fireworks!

response.speaker: Pengyi
response.text: Ah, you must be busy with other things, I suppose? In that case, pop by again when you're free — but don't go through this Lantern Rite without making a few fireworks, you hear?
